as_told.title: Special forces unit fought a giant in Afghan caves

plain: In 2005, near Kandahar in Afghanistan, a giant humanoid is said to have killed a team of American scouts in a cave and was then shot dead by other soldiers. Tim Alberino passes this on from a man who says he was there. He describes the soldiers finding "this gigantic humanoid was eating on one of them." Michels retells it more briefly and gives no date or place: he says the man and his unit claim to have fought the giant in the caves, which the episode title puts at 12 feet tall. If true, it would mean giant beings are real and that the US military has killed one.
